decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the necessary mounting-hole-clearance impact. Minimum spacing between connectors belongs to connector accessibility and need not be duplicated in the form-factor state.
Physical clearance and spacing between power-board connectors do not change the NTC monitoring function, controller, or connector assignment.
The connector-layout constraints do not change the battery electrical-protection controller or cutoff behavior.
Power-board connector clearance does not alter the main-board SK6812 charge-status interface.
The source concerns placement clearance between power-board connectors, not USB enumeration, data lines, or USB connector sourceability.
The mechanical connector-spacing decision does not change the addressable-LED family, power interface, or data GPIO.
Connector placement clearance does not change the 5V boost converter, enable control, default state, or powered loads.
The source decision does not change I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up board location.
